item.title: From vastly different backgrounds, Super Bowl coaches Mike Vrabel, Mike Macdonald strike perfect tone
item.description: <p>SAN JOSE, Calif. — As the Patriots and Seahawks stalled in their rebuilds, both organizations needed a jolt. item.title: Looking resigned to defeat, Blackhawks get blanked by Blue Jackets

item.title: Woman killed, man injured in Auburn Gresham shooting
item.description: <p>A woman was killed and a man was injured in a shooting Wednesday in Auburn Gresham, according to Chicago police.</p><p>A woman, 26, and a man, 27, were in a car in the 7900 block of South May Street at 1:25 p.m. when they were shot, causing the vehicle to crash into an SUV, police said. The woman was shot several times and was taken to Little Company of Mary Medical Center, where she later died, police said.</p><p>The man was taken to Christ Medical Center in good condition, police said.
